notes.title: Sale, Bundle changes
notes.notes:
Hello,

due to the Release of "ReThink Evolved 2" this game will go on sale tomorrow, for 14 days. (I messed up the date, initially i wanted to have it go on sale right now... sorry)


Besides that, i changed the Bundle so that this game is bundled with the new game instead of the old one.


Thats all for now, thank you.

notes.title: [Update 2] Elevators, Small changes
notes.notes:
Hello,

I changed the behavior of the elevators in the game.
They now don't go down on their own.

They also got a Symbol on their side to make them better visible if they align with a wall.

I also repositioned most of the Reset-Buttons to avoid activation by accident.

I also changed a few other things that are not really important enough to list them here.

Thank you.
